project.name: osgi/domains/crypto/cellar-cipher-age
project.description: The age realisation of the seed-broker CellarCipher seam, backed by jagged (age over the JDK JCA) through jagged-wrap. It seals / reveals a cellar SEALED entry with the rke2-cluster OpenSSH key DIRECTLY — jagged's ssh-ed25519 recipient support converts the key internally (ed25519→X25519), so there is NO ssh-to-age tool, NO separate age key, and NO environment: the single source of trust is the ndh key inventory. Reads the key through NdhKeystoreReader (seals to keys.rke2-cluster.public, reveals with keys.rke2-cluster.private). Published as an immediate @Component(service=CellarCipher.class) with a MANDATORY reference to NdhKeystoreReader, so the age service exists only where the inventory is reachable; elsewhere the seed-broker's PassphraseCellarCipher stand-in fills in. A domain module (it consumes a domain contract) — the crypto library it rides on (jagged-wrap) stays in osgi/runtime. See docs/architecture/atlas/cellar-secrets.adoc.
